name: geow2-scores
description: A score server for a group of geow2 players: shared high scores, unlocks and achievements

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply geow2-scores --remote

ADMIN_SECRET.description: The password for the server's admin page (/admin), where you invite your friends. Pick a long one and keep it.

GROUP_NAME.description: Your group's name, shown on the server's pages and in the game. For example: Friday Night Grid.
